verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows BigQuery offering a governed semantic model where metrics, dimensions and joins are declared once and both SQL queries and AI tools resolve against it. Conversational analytics data agents can be configured with glossary terms and verified queries, but that is AI-agent context rather than a declared semantic layer. Dataform transformations and views are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can define a governed semantic model — metrics, dimensions, and joins declared once — that queries and AI tools answer against consistently
